description: Acid-catalyzed transformation of 1,2-diols to give the corresponding rearranged ketones or aldehydes.

name: Prins-Pinacol rearrangement
description: Formation of oxacyclic and carbocyclic ring systems by terminating Prins cyclizations with the pinacol rearrangement in a tandem fashion.

name: Pummerer rearrangement
description: Formation of α-substituted sulfides from the corresponding sulfoxides.

name: Schmidt reaction
description: Reaction of carboxylic acids and carbonyl compounds with hydrazoic acid or alkyl azides to afford the corresponding amines, nitriles or amides, respectively.

name: Wagner-Meerwein rearrangement
description: Generation of a carbocation followed by the [1,2]-shift of an adjacent carbon-carbon bond to generate a new carbocation.

name: Baeyer-Villiger oxidation/rearrangement
description: Transformation of ketones to esters and cyclic ketones to lactones by peroxyacids.

name: Cornforth rearrangement
description: Thermal rearrangement of 4-carbonyl substituted oxazoles to their isomeric oxazoles.

name: Curtius rearrangement
description: Thermal or photochemical rearrangement of acyl azides to give isocyanates.

name: Wolff rearrangement
description: Thermal or photochemical rearrangement of α-diazo ketones to form ketenes.

name: Stevens rearrangement
description: Base-promoted transformation of sulfonium or quaternary ammonium salts to sulfides or tertiary amines.

name: Aza-Claisen rearrangement
description: Thermal [3,3]-sigmatropic rearrangement of N-allyl enamines.

name: Aza-Cope rearrangement
description: Thermal [3,3]-sigmatropic rearrangement of N-substituted 1,5-dienes.

name: Aza-Wittig rearrangement
description: Thermal [3,3]-sigmatropic rearrangement of allylic tertiary amines to give homoallylic secondary amines.

name: Carroll rearrangement
description: Thermal [3,3]-sigmatropic rearrangement of allylic β-keto esters to afford γ,δ-unsaturated ketones.

name: Claisen rearrangement
description: Thermal [3,3]-sigmatropic rearrangement of allyl vinyl ethers to give γ,δ-unsaturated carbonyl compounds.

name: Claisen-Ireland rearrangement
description: Thermal [3,3]-sigmatropic rearrangement of O- trialkylsilylketene acetals to γ,δ-unsaturated carboxylic acids.

name: Cope rearrangement
description: Thermal [3,3]-sigmatropic rearrangement of 1,5-dienes to the isomeric 1,5-dienes.

name: Eschenmoser-Claisen rearrangement
description: Thermal [3,3]-sigmatropic rearrangement to generate γ,δ- unsaturated amides from allylic alcohols and N,N- dimethylacetamide dimethyl acetal.

name: Johnson-Claisen rearrangement
description: Thermal [3,3]-sigmatropic rearrangement of allyl ketene acetals to afford γ,δ-unsaturated esters.

name: Meisenheimer rearrangement
description: Thermal rearrangement of certain tertiary amine N-oxides to the corresponding O-substituted-N,N-disubstituted hydroxylamines.

name: Mislow-Evans rearrangement
description: Reversible 1,3-transposition of allylic sulfoxide and allylic alcohol functionalities.

name: Overman rearrangement
description: The 1,3-transposition of alcohol and amine functionalities via the [3,3]-sigmatropic rearrangement of allylic trichloroacetimidates.

name: Oxy-Cope rearrangement
description: Thermal [3,3]-sigmatropic rearrangement of 1,5-diene-3- ols to afford δ,ε-unsaturated carbonyl compounds.

name: Sommelet-Hauser rearrangement
description: The thermal [2,3]-sigmatropic rearrangement of benzylic quaternary ammonium salts in the presence of a strong base.

name: Birch reduction
description: 1,4-Reduction of aromatic rings using alkali metals dissolved in liquid ammonia as reducing agents.

name: Clemmensen reduction
description: Conversion of a carbonyl group to the corresponding methylene group using Zn(Hg)/HCl.

name: Corey-Bakshi-Shibata reduction
description: Enantioselective reduction of ketones with BH3 using oxazaborolidines as catalysts.

name: Eschweiler-Clarke methylation
description: One-pot reductive methylation of primary and secondary amines to the corresponding tertiary amines using formaldehyde and a reducing agent.

name: Luche reduction
description: Reduction of enones to the corresponding allylic alcohols using CeCl3/NaBH4.

name: Meerwein-Ponndorf-Verley reduction
description: The reduction of aldehydes and ketones by metal alkoxides to the corresponding alcohols

name: Midland Alpine borane reduction
description: Enantioselective reduction of ketones using Alpine borane.

name: Noyori asymmetric hydrogenation
description: Formation of enantio-enriched carboxylic acids, alcohols and amino acids from unsaturated carboxylic acids, allylic alcohols and enamides, respectively.

name: Staudinger reduction
description: Reduction of azides with triphenylphosphine.

name: Stephen aldehyde synthesis
description: Reduction of nitriles with SnCl2/HCl to give the corresponding aldehydes.

name: Tishchenko reaction
description: Conversion of aldehydes to the corresponding esters in the presence of metal alkoxides.

name: Wolff-Kishner reduction
description: Deoxygenation of aldehydes and ketones under basic conditions to give hydrocarbons via the corresponding hydrazones or semicarbazones.

name: Benzilic acid rearrangement
description: Rearrangement of 1,2-diketones to give the salts of α- hydroxy acids.

name: Favorskii rearrangement
description: Skeletal rearrangement of α-halo ketones via a cyclopropanone intermediate to give carboxylic acids or carboxylic acid derivatives.

name: Quasi-Favorskii rearrangement
description: Skeletal rearrangement of bicyclic α-halo ketones in which the halogen is located at the bridgehead position to afford carboxylic acids or carboxylic acid derivatives.

name: Buchner method of ring expansion
description: Thermal or photochemical reaction of ethyl diazoacetate with benzenes and its homologs to give the isomeric esters of cycloheptatriene carboxylic acid.

name: Ciamician-Dennstedt rearrangement
description: Synthesis of 3-halopyridines from pyrroles and 2- haloquinolines from indoles.

name: Demjanov and Tiffeneau-Demjanov rearrangement
description: The ring enlargement of 1-aminomethyl cycloalkanes to the corresponding cycloalkanols and the ring- enlargement of 1-aminomethyl cycloalkanols to the corresponding cycloalkanones.

name: Castro-Stevens coupling
description: The copper(I)-mediated coupling of aryl or vinyl halides with aryl- or alkyl-substituted alkynes to afford disubstituted alkynes or enynes.

name: Glaser coupling
description: Preparation of symmetrical conjugated diynes and polyynes by the oxidative homocoupling of terminal alkynes in the presence of copper salts.

name: Ullmann biaryl ether synthesis
description: Cu-mediated synthesis of biaryl ethers by coupling aryl halides and phenols.

name: Ullmann reaction
description: Cu-mediated coupling of two aryl halides to afford symmetrical or unsymmetrical biaryls.

name: Buchwald-Hartwig cross-coupling
description: Direct Pd-catalyzed C-N and C-O bond formation between aryl halides and amines or alcohols.

name: Heck reaction
description: Pd-catalyzed arylation or alkenylation of olefins.

name: Kumada cross-coupling
description: Cross-coupling of alkenyl- or aryl halides and Grignard reagents or organolithium species.

name: Larock indole synthesis
description: Preparation of 2,3-disubstituted indoles from ortho- iodoanilines and disubstituted alkynes.

name: Miyaura boration
description: Pd-catalyzed cross-coupling of aromatic and heteroaromatic halides or triflates with tetraalkoxydiboron compounds to give arylboronic and heteroarylboronic esters.

name: Negishi cross-coupling
description: Pd- or Ni-catalyzed cross-coupling of organozincs and aryl- or alkenyl- or alkynyl halides.

name: Sonogashira cross-coupling
description: Cu-Pd-catalyzed coupling of terminal alkynes with aryl and vinyl halides to give enynes.

name: Stille carbonylative cross-coupling
description: Pd-catalyzed coupling of organostannanes and alkenyl- or aryl halides and CO to form ketones.

name: Stille cross-coupling
description: Pd-catalyzed coupling of organostannanes and alkenyl- or aryl halides.

name: Stille-Kelly coupling
description: Pd-catalyzed intramolecular biaryl coupling of aryl halides or aryl triflates in the presence of distannanes.

name: Suzuki cross-coupling
description: Pd-catalyzed coupling between organoboron compounds and organic halides and triflates.

name: Tsuji-Trost allylation
description: Pd-catalyzed allylation of carbon nucleophiles with allylic compounds via -allylpalladium complexes.
